shard.description: Who is asking, for people: a machine, a CI job. Shards need not know each other

definition.description: The version of a published definition

where.description: Only units whose every item has one of these values in each named dimension

collection.description: What retry limits are counted in (a CI run id). Default: the definition version

staleBeforeMs.description: Hand out captured items whose result was recorded before this time, oldest first

idempotencyKey.description: Retrying with the same key returns the same claim, never a second batch
